fullContent:
Vrihat Vatchintamani Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Vatavyadhi Rogadhikara – 502 – 505 
 Vrihat Vatchintamani Ras is an Ayurvedic tablet. It is used in the treatment of Vata Dosha imbalance diseases such as paralysis, hemiplegia, facial palsy, tremors etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Swarna Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Gold – 30 g 
 Rajata Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Silver – 20 g 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Bhasma (calx) of Mica – 20 g 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Iron – 50 g 
 Pravala Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Coral – 30 g 
 Mukta Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Pearl – 30 g 
 Suta Bhasma – A compound of purified and processed Mercury and Purified Sulphur – 7 parts 
 Juice extract of Aloe vera quantity sufficient 
 
 How to Make? 
 Make fine powder of above ingredients and ground with the aloe vera juice extract then made into paste and finally pills are prepared. 
 Dosage 
 125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
It is traditionally administered along with honey, Musta Kashaya. 
 Indications 
 
 Paralysis 
 Facial paralysis 
 Psychosis 
 Epilepsy 
 Pitta disorders such as migraine, vertigo, digestive disorders 
 
 Side Effects 
 Note – Avoid Self-medication with this medicine. 
 It should be taken under medical supervision in prescribed dose for limited period of time or as advised by doctor. Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect. 
 It is best to be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
